newsitem.title: SPAIN: NYSE's Grasso sees enthusiasm for Boeing deal.
newsitem.headline: NYSE's Grasso sees enthusiasm for Boeing deal.

text.p: The merger of Boeing and McDonnell Douglas should be greeted enthusiastically by investors, New York Stock Exchange Chairman Richard Grasso said on Monday.
Grasso, speaking at a news conference in Madrid, said the merger was in line with a trend toward consolidation in the aerospace industry.

"It is important to recognise that creating a strong company is really the primary goal of that combination and so that strength should translate into enthusiasm from the investment community," Grasso said.
The merger "continues the consolidation in the United States and worldwide...in that industry," he said.
